text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambia press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The environmental council will ship over 300,000 tonnes of expired pesticides from Lusaka to Europe where it will be destroyed.
- An expelled official of former president Kenneth Kaunda's United National Independence Party (UNIP) has called for fresh party elections.
- Vice President Godfrey Miyanda leaves for Namibia for the first bi-annual Zambia-Namibia Trade and Investment Rendevous and the Namibian International Trade Fair.
- A Lusaka court has sentenced to death a woman who strangled her one-year-old child.
